profile.address: 32 Avenue of the Americas, Tribeca, New York, NY 10013
profile.reading: Per the English Wikipedia article on 32 Avenue of the Americas, this Tribeca, Manhattan building (also known as 32 Sixth Avenue, ZIP 10013) totals 1.17 million square feet of office space (800,000 sq ft when it first opened as rentable space). Built in three phases from 1914 through 1932 as the AT&T Long Distance Building, it was designated a New York City landmark in 1991 and renovated 2001 to 2002. The 24th floor houses The Hub, a carrier neutral colocation and interconnection facility serving over 50 terrestrial carriers, content providers, ISPs, and enterprise tenants.
profile.capacity_note: Colocation and interconnection facility (The Hub) occupies the 24th floor of a larger mixed use office building; no MW figure published
